items.prompt: AB = 4 maps to DE = 12, BC = 5. Find EF.

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Before solving, say which error the problem is testing for.

items.prompt: A 3 m pole casts a 5 m shadow. At the same moment a building casts a 25 m shadow. How tall is the building?
The Pythagorean theorem can be proved using similarity. Which statement correctly justifies it?
choices: The theorem follows from the triangle inequality.
The altitude to the hypotenuse creates two triangles similar to the original; writing both similarity proportions and adding them yields a² + b² = c².
Similarity gives a² + b² = c² only for isosceles right triangles.
The theorem follows because all right triangles are similar to each other.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is similar to triangle DEF. Side AB = 10 corresponds to DE = 20. If BC = 6, find EF.
In a right triangle, the altitude to the hypotenuse divides it into segments of length 5 and 20. Find the altitude.

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: A 4 m pole casts a 5 m shadow. At the same moment a building casts a 20 m shadow. How tall is the building?
A line parallel to one side of a triangle divides the other two sides proportionally. Which statement correctly justifies it?
choices: The two parts of each side are congruent because the line is parallel.
The result follows from the Pythagorean theorem applied twice.
The parallel line creates corresponding angles, giving a smaller triangle similar to the original by AA, so the sides are in proportion.
The parallel line bisects both sides by definition.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC is similar to triangle DEF. Side AB = 6 corresponds to DE = 24. If BC = 7, find EF.
